tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

arguments.title: CS Auto-Nudge Roles — 2028-01-01
arguments.body:
# CS Auto-Nudge Role Reference

- **Routine exception ledger and operating explanation:** Owen owns and maintains the routine exception ledger.
- **Ines’s lane:** Ines may independently close only routine CS auto-nudge messaging-state reviews and provide routine operator guidance, when governed fields are current and consistent, the messaging and nudge views agree, and no escalation condition applies. She has no engineering release-control access.
- **Escalations:** Customer corrections, incident stops, state-changing, ambiguous, exception-heavy, disputed-semantics, or cross-surface issues leave Ines’s routine lane and escalate to the designated decision owner.
- **Engineering boundary:** Daniela retains engineering release and rollback control; it is not delegated to Ines.

This reference is limited to CS auto-nudge routine messaging-state review and guidance; it does not grant Ines authority over other consumers or change lifecycle-send release limits.
